scripts.todo:perf: pnpm run bench:perf:record && pnpm exec tsx tools/todo/update-performance-section.ts
scripts.app:build: pnpm config:sync && pnpm wasm:build && vite build --config web/vite.config.ts
scripts.app:lint:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --all-targets
scripts.bench:perf:baseline:geology-solo: pnpm bench --suite geology_solo && pnpm bench:compare:geology-solo -- --write-baseline tests/perf/geology-solo-baseline.json
scripts.bench:alpha:transition:strict: ALPHA_TRANSITION_LAND_RATIO_MIN=0.20 ALPHA_TRANSITION_LAND_RATIO_MAX=0.40 ALPHA_TRANSITION_MAX_LAND_RATIO_JUMP=0.02 ALPHA_TRANSITION_MAX_SEA_LEVEL_JUMP=0.05 cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --bin alpha_transition_guard --
scripts.bench:resample:earth-plate-id: uv run --python 3.11 --with pygplates python benches/scripts/resample.py --module earth-plate-id --centroids benches/data/cell_centroids.csv
scripts.bench:resample:ecology-ref: python3 benches/scripts/resample.py --module ecology-ref --centroids benches/data/cell_centroids.csv --output benches/data/ecology_ref.bin --tree-cover benches/raw/ecology/mod44b_tree_cover.tif --non-tree-cover benches/raw/ecology/mod44b_non_tree_cover.tif --bare-cover benches/raw/ecology/mod44b_non_vegetated.tif --landcover benches/raw/ecology/mcd12q1_lc_type1.tif --landuse benches/raw/ecology/mcd12q1_lc_prop2.tif --temperature benches/raw/climate/worldclim_tavg_annual_c.tif --precipitation benches/raw/climate/worldclim_prec_annual_mm.tif --river-flow benches/raw/hydrology/glofas_era5_annual_mean.nc --height benches/raw/geology/ETOPO_2022_v1_60s_N90W180_surface.tif --method bilinear
scripts.bench:resample:ecology-ref:with-soil: python3 benches/scripts/resample.py --module ecology-ref --centroids benches/data/cell_centroids.csv --output benches/data/ecology_ref.bin --tree-cover benches/raw/ecology/mod44b_tree_cover.tif --non-tree-cover benches/raw/ecology/mod44b_non_tree_cover.tif --bare-cover benches/raw/ecology/mod44b_non_vegetated.tif --landcover benches/raw/ecology/mcd12q1_lc_type1.tif --landuse benches/raw/ecology/mcd12q1_lc_prop2.tif --temperature benches/raw/climate/worldclim_tavg_annual_c.tif --precipitation benches/raw/climate/worldclim_prec_annual_mm.tif --river-flow benches/raw/hydrology/glofas_era5_annual_mean.nc --height benches/raw/geology/ETOPO_2022_v1_60s_N90W180_surface.tif --soil-dir benches/raw/ecology/soilgrids --soil-suffix 0p1deg --soil-w-0-5 5 --soil-w-5-15 3.5 --soil-w-15-30 1.5 --method bilinear
scripts.bench:resample:domesticates-ref: python3 benches/scripts/resample.py --module domesticates-ref --centroids benches/data/cell_centroids.csv --output benches/data/domesticates_ref.bin --manifest benches/raw/domesticates/manifest.json --method bilinear
scripts.bench:perf:run:dev: pnpm wasm:build:dev:no-sync && pnpm exec tsx tests/perf/scripts/perf.ts
scripts.bench:perf:record: pnpm wasm:build:dev:no-sync && pnpm exec tsx tests/perf/scripts/perf.ts --ticks 16 --seed alpha --no-geometry --sample-interval 4 --verification-mode interactive --lane wasm --record
scripts.bench:perf:baseline:wasm: pnpm wasm:build:dev:no-sync && pnpm exec tsx tests/perf/scripts/perf.ts --ticks 16 --seed alpha --no-geometry --sample-interval 4 --verification-mode interactive --lane wasm --out tests/perf/bench-baseline-wasm.json
scripts.bench:perf:baseline:worker: pnpm wasm:build:dev:no-sync && pnpm exec tsx tests/perf/scripts/perf.ts --ticks 16 --seed alpha --no-geometry --sample-interval 4 --verification-mode interactive --lane worker --out tests/perf/bench-baseline-worker.json
scripts.bench:perf:baseline:native: pnpm exec tsx tests/perf/scripts/perf.ts --ticks 16 --seed alpha --sample-interval 4 --lane native --out tests/perf/bench-baseline-native.json
scripts.bench:perf:baseline: pnpm run bench:perf:baseline:wasm && pnpm run bench:perf:baseline:worker && pnpm run bench:perf:baseline:native
scripts.bench:perf:gate:wasm: pnpm wasm:build:dev:no-sync && pnpm exec tsx tests/perf/scripts/perf.ts --ticks 16 --seed alpha --no-geometry --sample-interval 4 --verification-mode interactive --lane wasm --baseline tests/perf/bench-baseline-wasm.json --threshold 0.25
scripts.bench:perf:gate:worker: pnpm wasm:build:dev:no-sync && pnpm exec tsx tests/perf/scripts/perf.ts --ticks 16 --seed alpha --no-geometry --sample-interval 4 --verification-mode interactive --lane worker --baseline tests/perf/bench-baseline-worker.json --threshold 0.25
scripts.bench:perf:gate:native: pnpm exec tsx tests/perf/scripts/perf.ts --ticks 16 --seed alpha --sample-interval 4 --lane native --baseline tests/perf/bench-baseline-native.json --threshold 0.35 --threshold-step-world 0.5
scripts.bench:perf:gate: pnpm run bench:perf:gate:native && pnpm run bench:perf:gate:wasm && pnpm run bench:perf:gate:worker
scripts.bench:perf:gate:climate: pnpm run bench:run:climate-series -- --runs 5 && pnpm run bench:check:climate-runtime -- --baseline tests/perf/climate-bench-baseline.json --threshold 0.15 && pnpm run bench:check:climate-quality -- --baseline tests/perf/climate-bench-baseline.json --window 5 --threshold-runtime 0.15 --max-temp-drop 0.01 --max-precip-drop 0.005 --max-aridity-drop 0.005
scripts.bench:perf:gate:hydrology: pnpm run bench:run:hydrology-series -- --runs 5 && pnpm run bench:check:hydrology-runtime -- --baseline tests/perf/hydrology-bench-baseline.json --threshold 0.15 && pnpm run bench:check:hydrology-quality -- --baseline tests/perf/hydrology-bench-baseline.json --window 5 --threshold-runtime 0.15 --max-flow-rho-drop 0.05 --max-lake-f1-drop 0.05
scripts.bench:perf:baseline:domesticates: pnpm bench --suite domesticates_solo && pnpm run bench:compare:domesticates -- --write-baseline tests/perf/domesticates-bench-baseline.json
scripts.bench:perf:gate:domesticates: pnpm bench --suite domesticates_solo && pnpm run bench:check:domesticates-quality -- --baseline tests/perf/domesticates-bench-baseline.json --threshold-runtime 0.20 --max-metric-drop 0.03 --max-regional-coverage-drop 0.05
scripts.test:seed:gate:quick:wasm: pnpm wasm:build:dev:no-sync && pnpm exec tsx tests/seed-regression/scripts/seed-regression.ts --seeds alpha,beta,gamma,delta --ticks 16 --jobs 2 --baseline tests/seed-regression/seed-regression-quick-baseline.json --check --threshold 0.005 --threshold-top10-river-flux-sum 0.01 --land-ratio-warn-min 0.24 --land-ratio-warn-max 0.35 --land-ratio-fail-min 0.20 --land-ratio-fail-max 0.40
scripts.test:seed:gate:heavy:wasm: pnpm wasm:build:dev:no-sync && pnpm exec tsx tests/seed-regression/scripts/seed-regression.ts --seeds alpha,beta,gamma,delta,eta,theta,kappa,mu --ticks 24 --jobs 2 --baseline tests/seed-regression/seed-regression-heavy-baseline.json --check --threshold 0.005 --threshold-top10-river-flux-sum 0.01 --land-ratio-warn-min 0.24 --land-ratio-warn-max 0.35 --land-ratio-fail-min 0.20 --land-ratio-fail-max 0.40
scripts.test:gate:validation: pnpm run bench:perf:gate:climate && pnpm run bench:perf:gate:hydrology
scripts.test:gate: pnpm run test:gate:contract && pnpm run test:gate:regression
scripts.test:gate:full: pnpm run test:gate && pnpm run test:gate:benchmark
